scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Assumes a finite base field of characteristic two and a finite-dimensional associative \(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\)-graded algebra.
The degree-zero component must be reduced; no claim is made for arbitrary fields or other grading groups.
The standalone finite checker validates the explicit M2(F2) field-grading example only; the general theorem is proved symbolically in RESULT.md.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Reduced neutral components force square-zero graded radicals and a graded Wedderburn complement
